entities.summary: Farooq Hamid Naek also spelled Farooq H. Naik, is a Pakistani politician and lawyer, who served as the Chairman Senate, Minister of Law as well as headed the Ministry of Justice (Pakistan) in the Government of Pakistan led by Prime Minister Yusuf Raza Gillani.
